Just going to throw these out there in case folks need something. They work best with an online data storage (DropBox, self-hosted, etc) if you have multiple devices or run multiple OS. These can even create passwords for you in whatever length and complexity you want.

KeePass https://keepass.info/

  • KeePass is the original and I believe only available on Windows. Still available in versions 1 and 2, it is the basis for a lot of these others as they use its database format. It has a ton of extensions. One nice thing is integration into most browsers, although it requires an extension for KeePass and a browser plugin. Also lists a ton of ports.

KeePassX https://www.keepassx.org/

  • First multi-platform port. Linux, OSx, Windows. Not much more I can say about it as it isn't much different than the original, just cross-platform.

KeePassXC https://keepassxc.org/

  • Personal favorite. Linux, MacOS, Windows. No extension needed for browser integration for most browsers, although it still needs plug-ins at the browser itself.

KeePassDroid http://www.keepassdroid.com/

  • Android port. Available on Play or FDroid.
KeePass and derivatives for Password Storage
